Title: Gandharva Music – Online Music Learning Platform
Tech Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare, Zoom SDK, Vercel, Railway
Highlights:
Developed a full-stack online platform for music education that enables students to browse courses,
schedule live classes with instructors, and book free trial sessions. The platform provides a seamless
experience across devices and integrates video, scheduling, and form-based interaction.
Frontend:
o Built using React.js with Tailwind CSS for responsive UI.
o Integrated Framer Motion for smooth page transitions and animations.
o Implemented React Router for multi-page SPA navigation
o Used Axios to interact with secure backend APIs.
o Integrated React Helmet for SEO optimization.
Backend:
o Developed RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
o Used MongoDB with Mongoose for schema-based data modeling.
o Implemented Nodemailer and SendGrid to send inquiry and trial booking confirmations.
o Integrated JWT-based authentication for potential student/instructor logins (future scalability).
Implemented live class scheduling by integrating the Zoom SDK for seamless 1:1 virtual music lessons.
Built a custom calendar UI to enable users to book free trial sessions effortlessly.
Deployed the front end on Vercel and hosted backend APIs on Railway for scalable performance.
Configured Cloudflare for DNS management, CDN delivery, and SSL encryption. Set up a custom
domain with full HTTPS support.
Ensured secure operations with HTTPS, CORS handling, input sanitization, and API rate limiting.
Enhanced performance through lazy loading and image optimization.
Title: Superr.bio – Personal Branding Web Application
Tech Stack: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
Highlights:
Built a performant and scalable personal branding web application using Next.js and React.js, enabling
users to create and showcase interactive digital bios with a clean and accessible user experience.
Designed a clean, modular front-end architecture using Next.js for optimized performance and server-
side rendering. Deployed seamlessly on Vercel with automated CI/CD workflows for fast and reliable
update.
Collaborated with design and product teams to build intuitive, responsive UI components using
Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Delivered a mobile-first, accessible interface optimized for non-
technical users.
Focused on writing maintainable, high-quality code by following modern front-end best practices.
Improved performance with lazy loading, dynamic imports, and Lighthouse optimizations. Ensured
reliability through unit and component testing using Jest and React Testing Library
Title: Co-WRITER
Tech Stack: Python, LangChain, Comet ML, Opik, MongoDB, Qdrant DB, Zen ML, Dockers, GitHub-Actions, AWS
SageMaker, FastAPI
Highlights:
Conceptualized and implemented Co-Writer a personalized AI capable of replicating individual writing
styles using advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques and LLAMA 3.1-8B.
Leveraged tools such as ZenML for pipeline orchestration, Comet ML for experiment tracking, and
Docker for containerization.
Utilized MongoDB as a NoSQL data warehouse and Qdrant for vector storage, supporting real-time
RAG.
Implemented optimization strategies, including quantization (using tools like GPTQ) and model
parallelism, to enhance inference speed by 25% and reduce resource usage.
Deployed LLM inference pipelines as FastAPI microservices with autoscaling capabilities.
Designed and implemented scalable CI/CD pipelines for continuous model training and deployment
on AWS SageMaker.
Applied domain-specific benchmarks and custom evaluation metrics using tools like Opik and ARES.
